sources.note: Entity designer help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: New entities can be created from the JPA Structure tab.
claims.supports: create a new entity from the JPA Structure tab

claims.statement: Adding in JPA Structure offers a JPA Converter or Hibernate CustomType.
claims.supports: select JPA Converter or Hibernate CustomType
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the BEHAVIOUR: our plugin offers a JPA attribute converter (code action 'Create attribute converter with preview…') and a Hibernate custom type (code action 'Create Hibernate user type…') for an entity attribute. Not checked: the original's Add button in the JPA Structure tool window and a single shared chooser; ours are two separate editor actions.
